newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-GIOVANNI LIFTS BARCELONA TO WIN OVER RED STAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GIOVANNI LIFTS BARCELONA TO WIN OVER RED STAR.

text.p: Barcelona hardly noticed the absence of striker Ronaldo in their European Cup Winners' Cup match against Red Star Belgrade on Thursday thanks to another matchwinning Brazilian -- midfielder Giovanni.
He scored twice in as many minutes as the Catalans came from behind to take a comfortable 3-1 victory into the second leg of the second round tie.

Red Star had taken the lead after 21 minutes through a freak goal by Bratislav Zivkovic, and Barcelona appeared subdued without top scorer Ronaldo, who missed the game to join the Brazilian squad for a friendly match.
Zivkovic broke down the left and slid in for a challenge with Barcelona midfielder Luis Enrique, causing the ball to balloon over Portuguese goalkeeper Vitor Baia into the net.
But 12 minutes later Giovanni chested home a fine left-foot volley by Bulgarian striker Hristo Stoichkov, and moments later he made it 2-1 by heading home a cross by Luis Figo.
Barcelona came out strongly in the second half and Figo put them further ahead after excellent work down the right by former Real Madrid player Luis Enrique, who had a superb game.

But Bobby Robson's side missed a chance to seal the tie midway through the second half when keeper Zvonko Milojevic saved a Gheorghe Popescu penalty after a handball during a scramble in the Red Star area.
The Yugoslavs were forced to defend in strength in the closing minutes and were reduced to 10 men when Vinko Marinovic picked up his second yellow card for pushing Giovanni.
